title: Token
description: An npm access token with its metadata. The actual token value is redacted; only the key hash is provided.

key.description: The hexadecimal SHA-512 hash of the token, used for identification.

token.description: A redacted representation of the token UUID.

cidr_whitelist.description: List of CIDR IP ranges that are allowed to use this token. Null if no restrictions are set.

readonly.description: Whether this token has read-only access.

automation.description: Whether this token is an automation token that bypasses two-factor authentication requirements for publishing.

created.description: The date and time the token was created.

updated.description: The date and time the token was last updated.
